approaches_tried.approach: Run new Check-E-exercising cases under the suite's default deploy-tree-first subject resolution
approaches_tried.reason: Resolves the stale deployed lint copy (pre-redeploy, no Check E yet) -> 'scan path not found: --deployed-settings'. Fixed by using CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store for verification during this phase; the default resolution will agree once Phase 6 redeploys.

notes: Added 7 new cases (19-25, with 23 split into 23a/23b) for a total of 26 case labels (19 pre-existing + 7 new). All 32 individual assertions pass under 'CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store bash scripts/tests/test-lint-hook-registration-paths.sh' (0 failed). A real pre-landing defect was caught and fixed during this phase: Check E's DEPLOYED_SETTINGS default unconditionally pointed at the REAL live .claude/settings.json, which would have made every pre-existing Check-A-D fixture case (1-18, each passing its own narrow custom scan path) spuriously trip Check E against the real deployed tree once the deployed copy eventually carries Check E -- fixed by withholding the default whenever an explicit scan path was given without an explicit --deployed-settings/env override (see issue-record.sh entry, class 'design defect caught before landing'). Re-verified byte-identical default-path output after the fix. The suite's DEFAULT (deploy-tree-first) invocation of test-lint-hook-registration-paths.sh itself will continue to show the new cases as failing against the STALE deployed copy until Phase 6's redeploy -- this is the suite's own documented, intentional pre/post-redeploy divergence signal (see common_test_resolve_subject's header comment), not a defect in this phase's work; Phase 6 closes this by construction. Likewise the five-suite run-all.sh tier shows test-lint-hook-registration-paths.sh newly listed alongside the two already-logged unrelated/EXPECTED failures (test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh) for the identical pre-redeploy reason; same deferred-to-Phase-6 resolution.
